title: Beetle King Council
description: A surreal scene depicts a giant crowned beetle-like creature with a turquoise body and golden rings hovering above a round table. Thirteen hooded skeletal figures in white robes sit around the table holding a staff with a glowing orb, set against a cosmic black and white background with colorful orbs and dripping paint effects.
prompt: A surreal dark fantasy painting shows a massive crowned beetle creature with a turquoise dripping body and multiple glowing golden rings floating above a circular table. Thirteen hooded skeletal figures in flowing white robes with black void faces are seated around the table, one holding a tall staff topped with a glowing orb. The background is split between a white cosmic void with colorful orbs on the left and a black starry space on the right, with paint drips in turquoise, purple and gold flowing down from the figures and creature.
